why_best: It translates complex backend computation into a tangible, rhythmic progression that builds trust in the updated figure.
why_bad: A sudden instantaneous snap or simple cross-fade would cheapen the sense of real-time data processing and make critical metric updates feel unverified.
trap: A near-miss will overshoot the target number or bounce playfully at the end, ruining the stern, authoritative tone required for high-level financial reporting.
